answer: A violet bed spreads by runners, yet every bloom traces back to one parent root. Weight rewards by root, not by bloom: each funding lineage earns exactly one jetty slot per epoch, a single docking point where nectar is dispensed against fresh, verified work. A farm can clone a thousand blooms, but they share one slot and one ration — identities cluster by funding root and dock as one ship. Idle roots lapse; standing decays without fresh cargo. The payout queue at each jetty is public, so anyone can watch a thousand-name fleet draw from one ration and price it as the single identity it is.
